prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, PPC, brand, creative, web/dev, B2B vs B2C), your industry, budget and timeline.

If you tell me a few details (type of marketing, industry, company size, monthly budget, and whether you need local presence vs. remote work), I can recommend the top 3–5 Maryland agencies that fit your needs and help you evaluate them.

Meanwhile, a few well-regarded Maryland agencies you might consider (by specialty):
- Mindgrub (Baltimore) — product design, mobile apps, web development and digital strategy for enterprise & startups.  
- Blue Corona (Gaithersburg) — data-driven SEO, PPC and analytics; strong with home services and small-to-mid businesses.  
- Red Chalk Studios (Baltimore) — website design/development, content and inbound marketing for midsize orgs.  
- Giant (Baltimore) — full-service creative, branding and integrated campaigns.

How to pick the right one:
- Define goals and KPIs up front (leads, revenue, awareness).  
- Ask for relevant case studies and references.  
- Check reviews (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn) and sample work.  
- Clarify reporting cadence, tools, team composition and pricing.  
- Start with a small test project if you can.

If you tell me your goals, industry and budget, I’ll shortlist agencies in Maryland that match and suggest questions to ask them.
